**API Compatibility:**
- All existing imports from `src/invoices.js` continue to work (lineTotal, invoiceTotals are re-exported)
- All 290 existing tests pass without modification
- The refactoring is transparent to users of the module

The codebase is now more modular with calculation logic separated from invoice management logic.
